'''Useria''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose [[Useria's moon|moon]] was home to the legendary [[Lunar Gardens]], which were in ruins by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
